name: Oathbloom Ceremonial Vial
description: A sealed ceremonial vial of prepared Oathbloom infusion, made at a specific oath-marking event and intended for that occasion — a ceremonial artifact, not a commodity.
narrative_effects: Used only at the oath-marking event for which it was prepared. Consumption by the oathtaker and witnesses is part of the ceremony's structure.
Not sold; not stored speculatively; not exported under any circumstance.
A non-elf offered an Oathbloom infusion and accepting it is participating as a full party to the oath being sworn.

mechanical_effect.trigger: used at the specific oath-marking event for which it was prepared and consumed by the oathtaker and witnesses as part of the ceremony
mechanical_effect.applies_to: checks to structure, witness, solemnize, or interpret the intended oath-marking ceremony
mechanical_effect.does_not_apply: other ceremonies; speculative storage; trade or export; attempts to use it outside the prepared oath event
